Ward F/S (Parel, Lalbaug, Sewri) has billed Rs 8026151 of its Rs 9800000 monsoon repair budget, or 81.9 percent, across 135 jobs. Only 26.7 percent of jobs met the promised repair time, and 15.6 percent were reopened within 30 days. This ward is low lying (index 0.85) and flooding is common. The city also had 18 days of heavy or worse rain, so some repeat damage is expected.

Still, Rs 676407 was billed on roads under DLP. That means the original contractor's warranty still covers these roads, so repairs should cost the city nothing. This needs review. Also, 8 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. The top contractor by spend is Arabian Sea Engineering (synthetic). Example work orders are WO25-00136 and WO25-00382.

Ask the ward office whether the warranty contractor was asked to fix those DLP roads before the city paid.
